about: Values taken from the UNCHANGED v775 build (commit bea0e51, source dev/tt.jsx as released in v775) by running TT_PROBE=1 node tests115.js on it, before any change: hashes of the Japanese Words list (Grammar review part open and closed), the Grammar for this track preview, the plan screen, the writer prompt block, the gate context, the plan, the track summary, the export, the GRAMMAR IN THIS TRACK screen and the rating card, for four states (n32 = the real learner: 32 grammar points introduced earlier and never rated, 150 known words; n3 = 3 points waiting for a rating beside rated ones; n5 = exactly 5 waiting; n0 = a blank grammar store), the Thai / Mandarin / Cantonese Words lists with the 32 points in the grammar store, and the code of the three generator screens, the Japanese generator and the Words list. tests115.js G1 compares the new build, with the two new switches off, to these.
